review_notes: Read the whole target file and KaroubiLinear.lean (where karoubiHomAddHom/karoubiHomLinearMap are defined), plus the Mathlib Karoubi simp lemmas (p_comp, comp_p, hom_ext_iff). The target file itself declares no simp lemmas. The only simp-interface problem I found is the missing coercion/apply lemma for the underlying-morphism maps. Its effect shows up in this file as `show ... from` casts and `x.f` unfolding. I did not run Lean, so I did not check how the proof would behave after the change. I also did not check the other users in MatSemisimple.lean and KaroubiSemisimple.lean beyond reading their call sites.

findings.excerpt: (show End P →ₗ[ℂ] End P.X from karoubiHomLinearMap P P)
findings.problem: `karoubiHomLinearMap` and `karoubiHomAddHom` are defined with `toFun g := g.f` but have no simp lemma for their application, such as `karoubiHomLinearMap P Q g = g.f`. They are also not marked `@[simps]`. The simplifier therefore cannot rewrite `(karoubiHomLinearMap P P) x` to `x.f`, and it cannot rewrite `τ.comp (karoubiHomLinearMap P P)` applied to `x` to `τ x.f`. The file works around this with `show End P →ₗ[ℂ] End P.X from ...` casts and by relying on definitional unfolding (`x.f`, `key := ha ⟨...⟩`). Every downstream user has to repeat this. Examples are the `FiniteDimensional.of_injective ... (fun _ _ h => Karoubi.Hom.ext h)` pattern in MatSemisimple.lean and KaroubiSemisimple.lean, and the `ha` hypothesis here, which is stated in terms of the opaque linear-map coercion.
findings.proposed_change: In KaroubiLinear.lean, add `@[simp] theorem karoubiHomLinearMap_apply (g : P ⟶ Q) : karoubiHomLinearMap P Q g = g.f := rfl`. Add the analogous `karoubiHomAddHom_apply`, or put `@[simps]` on both definitions. Mathlib already has `@[simp] Karoubi.hom_ext_iff` (`f = g ↔ f.f = g.f`), so the injectivity argument becomes a `simp`-closable goal. Once this lemma exists, `simp` can normalise `(τ.comp (karoubiHomLinearMap P P)) x` to `τ x.f`, so the `show ... from` casts and the manual `ha` instantiation can be shortened.
findings.benefit: Terms built from the underlying-morphism linear map reduce to the canonical form `g.f` under `simp`. The `show`-cast boilerplate and defeq-dependent steps go away in this proof and in the other users of `karoubiHomLinearMap`.

evidence.excerpt: theorem hom_ext_iff {P Q : Karoubi C} {f g : P ⟶ Q} : f = g ↔ f.f = g.f
